description: Returns one person's business email and LinkedIn profile, by a person id from get_loan_companies. Each new person opened counts against the account's monthly allowance (50 on Pro, 250 on Team; the same person again that month is free), and the answer says how many are left. Business use only; not a consumer report; no extracting or resale. Without a paid cmbs.news plan it returns a tool error that says so.

person.description: A person id from get_loan_companies (16 hex characters)
